examples.title: Actions
examples.source: import Table from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/table.marko"; import TableHeader from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/header.marko"; import TableBody from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/body.marko"; import TableRow from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/row.marko"; import TableHead from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/head.marko"; import TableCell from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/cell.marko"; import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko"; import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko"; static const ITEMS = [ { value: "edit", label: "Edit" }, { value: "duplicate", label: "Duplicate" }, { type: "separator" }, { value: "delete", label: "Delete", variant: "destructive" }, ] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[]; static const products = [ { name: "Wireless Mouse", price: "$29.99" }, { name: "Mechanical Keyboard", price: "$129.99" }, { name: "USB-C Hub", price: "$49.99" }, ]; Product Price Actions ${product.name} ${product.price} <@trigger|triggerProps|>
examples.description: A table showing per-row actions using a `DropdownMenu` in the last cell.

examples.title: Selected row
examples.source: import Table from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/table.marko"; import TableHeader from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/header.marko"; import TableBody from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/body.marko"; import TableRow from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/row.marko"; import TableHead from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/head.marko"; import TableCell from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/cell.marko"; Invoice Status Amount INV001 Paid $250.00 INV002 Pending $150.00
examples.description: Add `data-state="selected"` to a `TableRow` to highlight it — the row's `hover:bg-muted` and `data-[state=selected]:bg-muted` styles handle the rest.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source: import Table from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/table.marko"; import TableHeader from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/header.marko"; import TableBody from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/body.marko"; import TableFooter from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/footer.marko"; import TableRow from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/row.marko"; import TableHead from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/head.marko"; import TableCell from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/cell.marko"; import TableCaption from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/table/caption.marko"; static const invoices = [ { invoice: "INV001", status: "مدفوع", method: "بطاقة ائتمانية", amount: "$250.00" }, { invoice: "INV002", status: "قيد الانتظار", method: "PayPal", amount: "$150.00" }, { invoice: "INV003", status: "غير مدفوع", method: "تحويل بنكي", amount: "$350.00" }, { invoice: "INV004", status: "مدفوع", method: "بطاقة ائتمانية", amount: "$450.00" }, { invoice: "INV005", status: "مدفوع", method: "PayPal", amount: "$550.00" }, { invoice: "INV006", status: "قيد الانتظار", method: "تحويل بنكي", amount: "$200.00" }, { invoice: "INV007", status: "غير مدفوع", method: "بطاقة ائتمانية", amount: "$300.00" }, ]; قائمة بفواتيرك الأخيرة. الفاتورة الحالة الطريقة المبلغ ${invoice.invoice} ${invoice.status} ${invoice.method} ${invoice.amount} المجموع $2,500.00
examples.description: `Table` and its parts restyle for right-to-left reading direction with no extra markup — set `dir="rtl"` on the `Table` root.
